static_traits.name: Lin Shan
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends to confide in, but has not yet fully shared relationship difficulties with them
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no history of psychotherapy/counseling
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent logic, able to self-Reflect and highly cooperative, tending to use absolutist and Self-deprecation expressions

basic_info.main_problem: I have noticed I am not very kind to my girlfriend, which has already caused problems in our relationship.
basic_info.core_demands: Realizing that my behavior is affecting our relationship and my physical and mental health prompted me to seek counseling at this time.

special_situations.event: Failed making breakfast (pancakes) last Sunday; the pancakes burned, ruining the girlfriend's plan to have breakfast together
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail at one thing, it proves my overall ability is poor and I am a terrible person/Chef
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Throwing the food away, labeling oneself with 'I am a bad Chef', distancing from or losing temper with girlfriend
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot even make pancakes; I am a terrible cook.

special_situations.event: Rising Work pressure; when in Low mood, small daily things do not go as planned
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If things do not go as planned, it means I am out of control and not good enough, and things will only get worse
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Raising self-Demands, being harsh on oneself, getting irritable with partner or Withdrawing to avoid exposing 'not being good enough'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I simply cannot cope with this situation; things will be a mess.

special_situations.event: Making mistakes or things going wrong in interactions with girlfriend (e.g. plans falling through, saying the wrong thing)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not perfect enough, my girlfriend will be disappointed and the relationship will deteriorate
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Preemptive negative Anticipation, trying less, avoiding or staying Silent to reduce chances of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter what I do, it is not good enough, and will disappoint her in the end.

special_situations.event: A small mistake occurs at work or during family activities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One mistake can represent overall ability and worth
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Wholly negating oneself, ignoring past successful experiences, stopping further attempts
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I messed up again; I am just a failure.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted by the partner and have her own worth seen, maintaining an intimate and harmonious connection
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure being negated, disappointing the other person to the point of being blamed or distanced
defense_goal: Maintains self-esteem and a sense of control by emphasizing external pressure and self-blame
Keeping some distance in the relationship to avoid being judged as 'not good enough'

object_relations.self_representation: A person who is not good enough, prone to failing and disappointing others
object_relations.object_representation: A partner who was hurt by me and is disappointed, who may judge me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor probes into the details and reasons of losing temper with girlfriend or 'messing things up'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worrying about being judged as 'not good enough', needing to prove the behavior was caused by the situation rather than one's own flaws
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing external causes (such as work stress) in an explanatory and restrained tone, weakening personal responsibility; using tactful wording and rational elaboration to reduce emotional exposure.

manifestations: Work stress has reduced interest in and enjoyment of singing and cooking
Once a mistake is made, experiencing intense failure and worthlessness, negating past successful experiences
outcomes: Irritability and Withdrawal aggravating Strained intimate relationships

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Negating oneself with absolutist labels when talking about mistakes (e.g. 'I am a failure/bad Chef')
Worrying that oneself is 'not good enough', thus Withdrawing in the relationship or trying less

exception_events.target_problem: When cooking mishaps occur or things do not go as planned, the client usually catastrophically negates oneself, and loses temper with partner or Withdraws, straining the Relationship.
exception_events.unique_outcome: The client mentioned 'I have made delicious meals before', which contrasts with the current 'I am a bad Chef', showing she can achieve positive results in other situations with a more balanced self-evaluation.
exception_events.reason: Clue: no obvious mistake had occurred at the time; noticing the good finished product and others' positive feedback, the self-evaluation was more objective, not yet defining overall ability by a single event.

positive_force: Aware of the problem and actively seeks help
Has had experiences of successful cooking and enjoying hobbies, which can serve as positive evidence
Has potential support resources in partner and a few friends
Able to accept cognitive restructuring and set specific small goals
negative_force: Easily self-deprecating and overgeneralizing in stressful situations
Losing temper with partner or Withdrawing to escape the discomfort of being judged
Work stress remains persistently high, amplifying negative emotions and interaction conflicts

antecedent: Low mood or already in an irritable state
target_behavior.core_reason: Under pressure, equating an individual mistake with total incompetence, triggering shame and worthlessness, avoiding being judged and the sense of failure through anger or Withdrawal
target_behavior.function: Escapes the painful emotions of criticism and failure, maintaining self-esteem and a sense of control short-term
target_behavior.consequence: Increased partner Relationship tension and conflict, heavier Self-blame and guilt, further decline in life enjoyment and Work performance

target_behavior.behavior: Negative self-labeling and repeated self-blame (e.g. 'I am a failure/bad Chef')
antecedent: A small mistake occurs during a task or daily activity
Situations others look forward to (e.g. having breakfast with partner) not yet realized
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralization and black-and-white thinking leading one to define overall ability and worth by a single mistake
target_behavior.function: Tries to prevent recurrence and gain a sense of control through harsh self-criticism
target_behavior.consequence: Rising Low mood and helplessness, avoiding new tasks, damaged relationships and quality of life
